top: ...as long as he sought the LORD,
...the LORD your God is gracious and merciful,
bottom: and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

top: ...but with us is the LORD our God
bottom: to help us, and to fight our battles...

top: ...all them whose spirit God had raised,
bottom: to go up to build the house of the LORD...

top: ...all the people shouted with a great shout,
For Ezra had prepared his heart
bottom: to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it...

top: So we fasted and besought our God for this:
bottom: and he was intreated of us.
